card.name: Space before a dose number in tables
card.fires_on: The space or first digit just before a dose number, mostly in opioid conversion tables and lists of equivalent doses. It also appears where numbers are split, such as 1|4 or 2|5.

modes.label: Opioid conversion tables
modes.description: The space after an opioid name in a dose-conversion table, just before the number.

modes.label: Equivalent-dose lists
modes.description: The space after a comma, before a listed equivalent opioid dose.
modes.example: 30 mg oral oxycodone HCl per day,<< >>8 mg oral hydromorphone

modes.label: Split digits
modes.description: The first digit of a number that the text breaks into pieces.
modes.example: One standard alcoholic drink contains <<1>>4 grams of pure alcohol

card.writes: The suppressed tokens relate to intoxication and are unrelated to the context, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires at the gap just before a dose number in opioid equivalence charts.
